authorReview.scope: Complete eight-sentence script checked against canonical short-reader opening evidence for premise, clear identity, specific interest and protected revelations.

independentReview.notes: Every spoken sentence reviewed against canonical English short reader for clear newcomer meaning, source grounding, curiosity and emotional intent. Replaced abstract promotional commentary with concrete viewer-facing language. All eight sentences have a distinct intended response and explicit restrained TTS direction; fictional later outcomes remain withheld. This is editorial review, not audience testing or rendered-audio approval.

sentenceIntentions.text: A model trained on medical spending may learn who gets care rather than who needs it.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Show spending as a potentially misleading proxy for need
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Recognize a concrete route into medical bias

sentenceIntentions.text: Bias in AI begins with the human choices already recorded inside apparently neutral data.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Name institutional history inside apparently neutral data
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Understand bias can precede model training

sentenceIntentions.text: Hospital records, hiring decisions, and speech samples each leave some experiences easier to see than others.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Compare whose experience becomes a record

sentenceIntentions.text: The book follows how those differences move from records into predictions and decisions about people's lives.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: See a causal path rather than an abstract fairness slogan

sentenceIntentions.text: A strong average score can conceal failures for people whose circumstances rarely reach the dataset.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Challenge the comfort of a strong average score
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Wonder whose failures the aggregate conceals

sentenceIntentions.text: Removing a sensitive label does not automatically remove the information connected to it.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Explain why removing a label may preserve its proxies
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Recognize the limits of a simple technical fix

sentenceIntentions.text: These examples make fairness a concrete question about what a system learns and whom it serves.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Tie fairness to learned information and affected people

sentenceIntentions.text: Start with how a dataset was made, before the model has learned anything at all.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Start before training at dataset construction
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Want to inspect the history behind the input
